caption: The drawing features a circular window design composed of several distinct elements arranged concentrically. At the center is a round grid with a brown frame, consisting of four vertical and four horizontal bars, forming several rectangular openings and revealing a blue-toned background that is lightest at the center and shaded with gradients of blue and green. Surrounding this grid is a wide circular band, also brown, which serves as the window’s framework. This band is bordered by a decorative outer ring that is filled with a repeating pattern of light blue and white flowers with green leaves, all outlined in brown. Around the circumference of the design, projecting outward from the border, are regularly spaced stylized brown triangular motifs with curling ends. The background is cream-colored and unadorned, providing high contrast to the multicolored and richly patterned circular form in the center. The bottom of the page contains the printed text "Scale 1' = 1'" and the small signature “THOVARD M. SHERKMAN ’26.”
title: Window in Choir Loft Looking South San Luis Rey Mission
